Other issues and anything worse than published 1.0.0 (0.1.0-rc.3/*/20261017-095917) or rc.3, with severity. N1, MINOR, new in rc.4: the blog home's 'Featured' became a full h2 opener ('Featured' plus 'The post we would hand a new colleague first.' plus 'Read the essay →'). Published had a mono 'FEATURED' label. The featured plate now starts about 200px lower, and the first 900px viewport holds two big headlines (the 'Field Notes' h1 and 'Featured') with only the top of the plate (blog/home-desktop-dark.png vs 0.1.0-rc.3/blog/20261017-095917/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png). The rc.2 rule 'every content section opens with the full opener' is being applied to a block that is the masthead's continuation. The featured title also wraps to three lines in a narrowed column. N2, MINOR, worse than published: the result counts lost their mono caption style. 'SHOWING 6 OF 6 POSTS' in published became 'Showing 6 of 6 posts' in body sans (blog/home-desktop-dark.png), and commerce reads 'Showing 11 products' (commerce/home-desktop-dark.png). Dashboard keeps mono 'SHOWING 8 OF 8 PROJECTS' (dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png), so the same caption differs across apps. The small 'Subscribe to the newsletter' line above the blog closing is also sentence-case sans, not a mono label. N3, MINOR, worse than rc.3: the mobile team pin head is visually hidden, so the right column is a bare number ('2', '3') with no visible label (dashboard/team-mobile-dark.png). rc.3 showed 'PROJECTS'. The spec permits sr-only 'when the pin holds a number', a rule from the rc.2 fix. N4, MINOR: on the about page the 'Why we write' description ('Practical notes from the people doing the work, edited lightly.') repeats the prose's second paragraph ('written by the people doing the work, edited lightly'). 'Latest writing →' appears under the description and again as an inline link in the prose's last paragraph, so the same link shows twice within 350px. The h2's left half stays empty for about 430px beside the prose (blog/about-desktop-dark.png y≈323–750). The reference sets section prose as a short paragraph beside the headline, not a column of three paragraphs (p1-desktop-light.png). N5, MINOR: the commerce desktop closing wraps 'Free shipping / over $100.' onto two lines at 1440px although it is 23 characters. The two-tone split dims 'over $100.', half of one phrase, where the reference keeps a closing sentence in one tone (commerce/home-desktop-dark.png vs p1-desktop-light.png 'Built for the future. Available today.'). N6, MINOR, process: settings did not implement 'the banner also opens the form' because the wording was unclear (settings/agent-report.md). On the captured screen it is not needed, as the banner and the first field are within one viewport. N7, NOTED, not scored: the blog footer is one line, as in published. rc.3's link column is gone, but that is not a regression against published (blog/home-desktop-dark.png vs 0.1.0-rc.3/blog/20261017-095917/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png). N8, NOTED: the payment-method card ends at x≈1251, as the fields do, while the plan grid and invoice table run to x≈1312 (settings/settings-billing-desktop-light.png). The form-column rule causes this, and it is minor.

Reference fidelity (4): this is the reference's language without copying it. Near-black ground, inverse pills, Inter 510/590 with tight tracking, mono uppercase captions, 48px split openers down content pages, two-tone statements, hairline grids of generative plates, the dot-column chart on a quiet stage with the teal current column, and now two-line display closings over the dot field on every width (blog/about-desktop-dark.png, blog/about-mobile-light.png, dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png vs pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png and p1-mobile-light.png). Not a 5: the lit product stage has no home in these apps (the spec allows this), and the blueprints are clean single outlines, still simpler than the reference's ribbed stack (blog/drawings/about-d1.png vs reference/illustrations/p1-i5.png).

Cross-app consistency (4): one family. The screen heads (mono label, h1, two-tone summary), the '01 / 0n' app section heads in settings and cart, the danger banner directly above the actions on every failed form (commerce/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png, settings/state-profile-errors-desktop-dark.png, blog/state-newsletter-error-desktop-dark.png), the right-aligned pins, the empty glyph with 'NO RESULTS', and two-line closings in both content apps are all shared. Drift: the result-count caption is mono in dashboard and sans in blog and commerce (N2), and type consistency fell to 0.869.

Hierarchy (4): app screens read screen head, then KPIs, then chart and activity, then table. Product detail reads meta, name, price, options, Add to cart. Articles now read title, meta, lead plate, then contents, on every width. The closing no longer outweighs the mobile page. Held back by N1, the 'Featured' opener pushing the lead story below the fold, and N4, the repeated description and link on the about page.

Spacing rhythm (4): the 4/8 scale holds. App padding is 32, the KPI gap 16, table rows are equal on desktop and mobile, and settings groups are now 48px from content to the next rule, including after the plan grid. The about row is level. Content sections keep the reference's generous gaps (about 150–185px between openers, as on p1-desktop-light.png). Minor: the security form's last button sits about 60 CSS px above the sessions rule on mobile, against 48 elsewhere (settings/settings-security-mobile-dark.png y≈1184 to 1280 at ×1.26).

Component states (4): focus is the 1px indigo outline plus the accent border, layered over the red error border (commerce/state-checkout-errors-mobile-light.png 'Full name', settings/state-profile-errors-desktop-dark.png). The banner sits above the actions in all three form apps. The empty filter shows the dot glyph, 'NO RESULTS', a two-tone line and 'Clear filters' (dashboard/state-empty-filter-mobile-light.png, blog/state-search-empty-desktop-light.png). The plan dialog is a mobile bottom sheet with a mono label, a 590 title, an inverse Confirm and a bordered Cancel (settings/state-plan-dialog-mobile-light.png). Segments show the pressed fill only. Not a 5: there is no captured pending state (harness gap), and the 'banner also opens the form' branch is unimplemented (N6).

Polish (4): every polish item from all four critiques is closed. What remains is small: the caption-style drift (N2), the hidden pin head (N3), the doubled link and echoing description (N4), and the commerce closing's mid-phrase dim (N5). No default-browser leftovers. Cleaner than published.
